name: Zeno Am-241 Survive-the-Night Package (Blue Ghost / CS-8 bonus)
full_name: Zeno Power Survive-the-Night Package — 5 Wt Am-241 RHU on a Firefly Blue Ghost near-side CLPS flight (NET 2028); NASA CS-8 STN bonus
mission: Firefly Blue Ghost near-side CLPS (NET 2028) / NASA CS-8 STN bonus
note: HEAT_VS_BONUS. 5 Watts thermal Am-241 RHU is heat, not electrical bus watts. Electrical keep-alive OPEN. Store OPEN. NASA CS-8 bonus = radioisotope + transmit after a full lunar night (duration, not watt-hours). Firefly PR does not print CS-8. Do not put Blue Ghost >400 W bus on this box. Do not use BGM1 5 h as this box's after_sunset.
electrical_model: 5 Wt is RHU heat (passive decay). Dedicated platform (comms/EPS/C&DH/thermal) is electrically powered — watts not printed. Do not treat 5 Wt as P_keepalive. Do not compute 5 Wt x 354 h watt-hours. LIVE_IF a printed electrical keep-alive W is covered through a printed full-night duration by a printed store.
witness_note: none flown — Zeno package NET 2028, pre-landing. BGM1 ~5 h after sunset is a different mission; cited only as why NASA pays a full-night radioisotope+transmit bonus. Do not use 5.0 h as this box's after_sunset. Do not join firefly_blue_ghost_m1 400 W as this box.
killer_heat_vs_bonus: 5 Wt is heat, not electrical bus watts. Electrical keep-alive OPEN. Store OPEN. NASA CS-8 bonus is radioisotope + transmit after a full lunar night (duration claim, not watt-hours). Do not compute 5 Wt x 354 h watt-hours. Do not put Blue Ghost bus watts on this box. Do not use BGM1 5 h as this box's after_sunset.
thermal_hold_md: No printed Zeno night hold T_box. Firefly/Zeno: RHU keeps critical components operational; night/PSR language below -280 F is design environment, not this box's printed sink. Allensworth >230 F / below -275 F is BGM1 measured, a different mission — not this T_env. T_env OPEN. Do not invent kelvin.
alloy_md: No printed night-path alloy. Fourier not run. Store OPEN. 5 Wt is heat, not a leak table.
honesty_md: We did not measure; Firefly 2026-08-19 / Zeno copy / NASA Ignition / Cataldo-Mason cited. 5 Wt thermal is heat. Electrical keep-alive not printed. Store not printed. Bonus hours not printed (120 h unverified, not used). Firefly printed no earlier than 2028, not the string CS-8. 14-day lunar night is qualitative, not 336 h watt-hours. Do not mix BGM1 5 h or Blue Ghost >400 W bus into this box.

P_thermal_W.quote: Zeno’s payload is comprised of a 5 Watts thermal americium-241 RHU and dedicated platform that includes structural, communications, electrical power, command and data handling, and thermal management subsystems.
P_thermal_W.cite: Firefly 2026-08-19 / Zeno copy: 5 Watts thermal americium-241 RHU. Identity: heat, not electrical bus watts.

rhu_heat.quote: The RHU generates passive thermal energy through the natural decay of radioactive material, providing continuous heat without relying on solar power.
rhu_heat.cite: Firefly 2026-08-19: RHU is passive heat. Not a printed electrical watt.

electrical_platform.quote: dedicated platform that includes structural, communications, electrical power, command and data handling, and thermal management subsystems
electrical_platform.cite: Firefly 2026-08-19: electrically powered subsystems named. Watts not printed.

P_keepalive_W.cite: OPEN — electrical keep-alive / night bus watts not printed. 5 Wt is heat. Do not treat RHU thermal as P_elec.
P_keepalive_W.close_with: Printed electrical keep-alive W for this Zeno package (not 5 Wt heat, not Blue Ghost bus watts).

store_Wh.cite: OPEN — Wh not printed. Do not invent watt-hours from 5 Wt x 354 h.
store_Wh.close_with: Printed nameplate or usable night store Wh for this package.

launch_NET.quote: Scheduled to launch no earlier than 2028
launch_NET.cite: Firefly 2026-08-19: no earlier than 2028. NASA CS-8: readiness by the end of 2028. NET as printed, not a landing date.

cs8_bonus.quote: NASA has included a performance bonus for contractors who successfully demonstrate “survive the night” capabilities by deploying a radioisotope device and transmitting signals from the lunar surface after enduring a full lunar night.
cs8_bonus.cite: NASA Ignition CS-8 Task Order 1.0. Duration + transmit, not watt-hours Wh. Hours not printed.
cs8_bonus.page_or_figure: Commercial Lunar Payloads Delivery CS-8 Task Order 1.0 Contract

cs8_readiness.quote: ensuring readiness for deployment by the end of 2028
cs8_readiness.cite: NASA Ignition CS-8: readiness by the end of 2028. Not a landing date.

cs8_deliveries.cite: NASA Ignition CS-8: deliveries through Fiscal Year 2029.

cs8_printed_on_firefly_pr.cite: Firefly 2026-08-19 prints existing Blue Ghost near-side CLPS NET 2028. Does not print the string CS-8. CS-8 is the NASA Ignition paid TO / bonus.

night_ops.quote: Zeno’s payload will then operate during the lunar night and transmit operational data back to Earth.
night_ops.cite: Firefly 2026-08-19: night operate + transmit. Watts not printed.

lander_solar_day.quote: Upon landing, Blue Ghost will first operate multiple NASA CLPS payloads using solar power for the full lunar day, equivalent to approximately 14 Earth days.
lander_solar_day.cite: Firefly 2026-08-19: lander NASA payloads on solar for the lunar day. Not this RHU's electrical watt. Not watt-hours hours.

cataldo_mason_night_h.quote: A complete lunar day cycle is 354 hours of sunlight and 354 hours of darkness.
cataldo_mason_night_h.cite: Cataldo & Mason, Survive and Operate Through the Lunar Night Workshop 2018 (LPI Contrib. 2106): 354 h of darkness. Duration identity for the NASA full-lunar-night bonus. Firefly/NASA Ignition do not print bonus hours. Not watt-hours Wh. Not BGM1 5 h.

H_night_h.cite: OPEN as watt-hours night length. NASA prints full lunar night, not hours. 120 h secondary reporting UNVERIFIED, not used. Cataldo/Mason 354 h is duration identity only. Do not multiply 5 Wt by 354 h.
H_night_h.close_with: Printed full-night hours for this CS-8 / Zeno bonus (not 120 h unless they print it; not BGM1 5 h).

bonus_hours_printed.cite: NASA Ignition does not print bonus hours. 120 h is UNVERIFIED and not used.

bgm1_why_bonus.quote: Our first Blue Ghost mission gave us firsthand insight into the Moon’s extreme thermal environment, where we measured temperatures ranging from more than 230°F during the lunar day to below -275°F at night.
bgm1_why_bonus.cite: Firefly 2026-08-19 Allensworth: BGM1 temps. Different mission. Why a full-night bonus exists. Not this box's after_sunset_h.
